name: Firecrawl Web Crawler & Research
description: Deep website crawling, clean LLM-ready markdown extraction, sitemap enumeration, and web research powered by Firecrawl.
author: Epic Think AI Team

tools.name: firecrawl_scrape
tools.description: Convert any URL into clean, structured Markdown, extracting page metadata, main content, and headers.

tools.name: firecrawl_crawl
tools.description: Crawl an entire website or domain up to a maximum page limit, extracting structured markdown for all reachable subpages.

tools.name: firecrawl_map
tools.description: Quickly enumerate all URLs, routes, and sitemaps belonging to a domain without downloading full page bodies.

tools.name: firecrawl_search
tools.description: Perform a deep web research search, returning clean markdown content of the top matching web pages.
